dedupe_keys.name: global pasture watch livestock reference samples from multi source sub national census data 2000 2024

description: This dataset harmonizes sub-national livestock census data from national and international agencies into one GeoPackage of administrative polygons with unit name, reference year, species and annual headcount for cattle, horses, goats, sheep and buffaloes. The Zenodo record says it combines the Global Pasture Watch census time series, the census polygons used for Gridded Livestock of the World version 4 and European cattle and sheep counts for 2010 and 2020, processed with an open pipeline on GitHub, and links to livestock density maps for 2000 to 2022. It was published in 2024 (v1) by authors at the OpenGeoHub Foundation, iDiv, IIASA, FAO and others under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as a 1.6 GB GeoPackage and a 3.9 GB raw census archive. Coverage is global. Caveats: reference years and units differ between countries. For simulation it gives livestock numbers by district to model animal exposure to drought, heat and disease and the feed and meat supply chain. Related catalogue records include the FAO Gridded Livestock of the World 2010 and the US cattle auction markets.
name: Global Pasture Watch - livestock reference samples from multi-source sub-national census data (2000-2024)
provider: Global Pasture Watch - OpenGeoHub Foundation, iDiv, IIASA, FAO and co-authors, via Zenodo
